name: GlobeNet

profile.research_note:
GlobeNet cable landing at Tuckerton confirmed; corporate ownership and building detail not confirmed this session. Revisit with fresh WebSearch budget.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This facility is in Tuckerton, New Jersey, attributed to GlobeNet, a submarine cable operator. Wikipedia coverage of Tuckerton confirms the town serves as a cable landing point for the GlobeNet submarine communications cable, and separately notes an underground facility originally built to Cold War specifications for earlier, now decommissioned cable systems including TAT-3, TAT-4, TAT-8, and TAT-14, some of which are recorded elsewhere in this registry under the AT&T operator entry for the same town. No further detail on GlobeNet corporate ownership, network route, or this facility building specific address, capacity, or MW figures were located in available sourcing this session.

reading: GlobeNet is a privately held wholesale telecommunications operator connecting the Americas over a subsea cable network spanning roughly 26,000 kilometers, owned as part of BTG Pactual's Infrastructure Fund II, a vehicle managed by the major Latin American investment bank BTG Pactual. GlobeNet's New Jersey presence centers on a cable landing station in Tuckerton, one of two US entry points for its network alongside a second landing station in Boca Raton, Florida, connecting United States network infrastructure to Latin American and Caribbean markets. Beyond network transport, GlobeNet has expanded into data center, IP, and security services, including a new data center in Barranquilla, Colombia and a new interconnection point in Fortaleza, Brazil, alongside the Malbec subsea cable extension reaching Argentina. As with other submarine cable operators, GlobeNet's New Jersey facility functions primarily as a cable landing station and associated network point of presence rather than a standalone wholesale colocation product marketed independently of its network transport business, a pattern distinct from the purpose-built colocation and hyperscale campuses that make up most of this registry's New Jersey facilities.
headquarters: not published (network operations center referenced in Brazil; corporate ownership under BTG Pactual)
